shares ticked up 1.2% on Wednesday as the domain name registry provider
the launch of the .web domain will start next month.

The Sunrise period begins on Dec. 10, 2026, and runs until Jan. 11, 2027, for verified trademark holders with Signed Mark Data files in the ICANN Trademark Clearinghouse. The Priority Access Program period will occur from Jan. 12, 2027, until April 5, when most existing .com registrants can register the matching .web domain name. And then from April 6, registration opens to the public on a first-come, first-served basis.
The news comes one day after Google
said it was launching three new domains — .eat, .fly, and .here — all of which are currently available via its Early Access Program ahead of a public release on Nov. 17.

title: VeriSign ticks up as it unveils timeline for .web domain launch
